s0101.literal: The chaste conduct of Wang, wife of Dadu commoner Liu Deren, was commended.
s0101.idiomatic: The chaste conduct of Wang, wife of Dadu commoner Liu Deren, was commended.

s0102.literal: On jiaxu day, the Prince of Xuanrang's prince tutor seal was granted.
s0102.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Prince of Xuanrang's prince tutor seal was granted.

s0103.literal: Prince of Jing Yesu Bugan presented tribute yak.
s0103.idiomatic: Prince of Jing Yesu Bugan presented tribute yak.

s0104.literal: The Land Tax Directorate General was ordered to remit mine-tax silver to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple.
s0104.idiomatic: The Land Tax Directorate General was ordered to remit mine-tax silver to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple.

s0105.literal: Xinghe Route was ordered to build a hawking mews for Yuelu Buhua.
s0105.idiomatic: Xinghe Route was ordered to build a hawking mews for Yuelu Buhua.

s0106.literal: Jingdong zhou native official Azhinong of Yunnan dispatched his son Hanwang to court, presenting a trained elephant, and requested that the zhou be elevated to Jingdong Military-Civilian Prefecture, with Azhinong as prefect and Hanwang as qianhu; beyond the regular levy, an annual additional tribute of five thousand taels of gold and seven hundred taels of silver was requested — granted.
s0106.idiomatic: Jingdong zhou native official Azhinong of Yunnan dispatched his son Hanwang to court, presenting a trained elephant, and requested that the zhou be elevated to Jingdong Military-Civilian Prefecture, with Azhinong as prefect and Hanwang as qianhu; beyond the regular levy, an annual additional tribute of 5,000 taels of gold and 700 taels of silver was requested — granted.

s0107.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve famine in Jiaozhou.
s0107.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve famine in Jiaozhou.

s0108.literal: Longyi Guard was ordered to use garrison-field annual grain revenue to support impoverished guard soldiers.
s0108.idiomatic: Longyi Guard was ordered to use garrison-field annual grain revenue to support impoverished guard soldiers.

s0109.literal: This month, in Shen and Ji two prefectures worms ate mulberry leaves, causing disaster.
s0109.idiomatic: This month, in Shen and Ji 2 prefectures worms ate mulberry leaves, causing disaster.

s0110.literal: Third month, bingzi new moon — Mars transgressed the Ghost lunar mansion.
s0110.idiomatic: Third month, bingzi new moon — Mars transgressed the Ghost lunar mansion.

s0111.literal: On xinsi day, censorate officials impeached and memorialized: "Yannan surveillance commissioner Bozan'er, formerly Minhai surveillance commissioner, accepted bribes totaling more than twenty-two thousand ingots of notes, more than five hundred taels of gold, more than three thousand taels of silver, twenty-two male and female bondservants, and countless other treasures — though encountering amnesty he was pardoned, we beg that his commission documents be stripped, his property registered and confiscated, and he be banished.
s0111.idiomatic: On xinsi day, censorate officials impeached and memorialized: "Yannan surveillance commissioner Bozan'er, formerly Minhai surveillance commissioner, accepted bribes totaling more than 22,000 ingots of notes, more than 500 taels of gold, more than 3,000 taels of silver, 22 male and female bondservants, and countless other treasures — though encountering amnesty he was pardoned, we beg that his commission documents be stripped, his property registered and confiscated, and he be banished.

s0112.literal: " An edict followed their words; his crimes were moreover exposed to show the empire.
s0112.idiomatic: " An edict followed their words; his crimes were moreover exposed to show the empire.

s0113.literal: On renwu day, civil and military officials attending southern suburban sacrifices were granted gold and silks in varying amounts.
s0113.idiomatic: On renwu day, civil and military officials attending southern suburban sacrifices were granted gold and silks in varying amounts.

s0114.literal: Shazhin Aihu Chi Bilate Nashiri was specially appointed Tripitaka National Preceptor and granted a jade seal.
s0114.idiomatic: Shazhin Aihu Chi Bilate Nashiri was specially appointed Tripitaka National Preceptor and granted a jade seal.

s0115.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes from the Shaanxi salt levy were used to relieve Mongol famine refugees at Chaghan Na'ur.
s0115.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes from the Shaanxi salt levy were used to relieve Mongol famine refugees at Chaghan Na'ur.

s0116.literal: On guiwei day, one thousand bolts each of silks and cloth from outer prefectures were allocated to the inner palace for supply needs.
s0116.idiomatic: On guiwei day, 1,000 bolts each of silks and cloth from outer prefectures were allocated to the inner palace for supply needs.

s0117.literal: On jiashen day, a true portrait of the crown prince was painted and installed in the East Stag-Peak Hall of Qingshou Temple, sacrificing to it with the rites of successive dynasties' spirit-shrine halls.
s0117.idiomatic: On jiashen day, a true portrait of the crown prince was painted and installed in the East Stag-Peak Hall of Qingshou Temple, sacrificing to it with the rites of successive dynasties' spirit-shrine halls.

s0118.literal: The eunuch Baizhu, attending the crown prince's rash illness, did not bring food at proper times, wiped butter on his eyes and nose, and moreover performed exorcistic incantations — he was beaten one hundred seven strokes and expelled from the capital.
s0118.idiomatic: The eunuch Baizhu, attending the crown prince's rash illness, did not bring food at proper times, wiped butter on his eyes and nose, and moreover performed exorcistic incantations — he was beaten 107 strokes and expelled from the capital.

s0119.literal: In Guan Prefecture worms ate more than four hundred thousand mulberry plants.
s0119.idiomatic: In Guan Prefecture worms ate more than 400,000 mulberry plants.

s0120.literal: Censorate officials said: "Kuizhang Pavilion associate compiler Yahu fawned on wicked ministers and acted unlawfully — his post should be dismissed.
s0120.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Kuizhang Pavilion associate compiler Yahu fawned on wicked ministers and acted unlawfully — his post should be dismissed.

s0122.literal: On bingxu day, earth rained; haze.
s0122.idiomatic: On bingxu day, earth rained; haze.

s0123.literal: Barsar resigned his concurrent post as superintendent of stored governance; not granted.
s0123.idiomatic: Barsar resigned his concurrent post as superintendent of stored governance; not granted.

s0124.literal: Bayan married a prince's daughter and was granted two hundred taels of gold and one thousand taels of silver.
s0124.idiomatic: Bayan married a prince's daughter and was granted 200 taels of gold and 1,000 taels of silver.

s0125.literal: To the eleven households of those who died for the state at Shangdu, including Buyan Temür, one hundred ingots of notes each were granted; one hundred men of Yan Temür's hawking establishment were granted shares.
s0125.idiomatic: To the 11 households of those who died for the state at Shangdu, including Buyan Temür, 100 ingots of notes each were granted; 100 men of Yan Temür's hawking establishment were granted shares.

s0126.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "The Taxation Intendant Office annually monopolizes merchant taxes, amounting to more than one hundred thousand ingots of notes; in recent years the yield has not met quota — we request that wherever monks and Taoists engage in trade, their taxes still be levied.
s0126.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "The Taxation Intendant Office annually monopolizes merchant taxes, amounting to more than 100,000 ingots of notes; in recent years the yield has not met quota — we request that wherever monks and Taoists engage in trade, their taxes still be levied.

s0127.literal: " An instruction said: "Those who are truly monks shall still be exempt.
s0127.idiomatic: " An instruction said: "Those who are truly monks shall still be exempt.

s0128.literal: " Minister over the Masses Hongshan said: "In Tao Hongjing's 'Hujia Lyric' there is the phrase 'bearing the throne-screen, flying through the heavenly calendar — in the end it is the jiachen lord'; Your Majesty's birth year and era name in fact match it — this is truly a token of receiving the mandate; we beg it be recorded and sent to the Historiography Office and proclaimed within and without.
s0128.idiomatic: " Minister over the Masses Hongshan said: "In Tao Hongjing's 'Hujia Lyric' there is the phrase 'bearing the throne-screen, flying through the heavenly calendar — in the end it is the jiachen lord'; Your Majesty's birth year and era name in fact match it — this is truly a token of receiving the mandate; we beg it be recorded and sent to the Historiography Office and proclaimed within and without.

s0129.literal: " An edict ordered the Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, Kuizhang Pavilion, and Ministry of Rites jointly to deliberate.
s0129.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, Kuizhang Pavilion, and Ministry of Rites jointly to deliberate.

s0130.literal: Hanlin scholars deliberated, considering: "During Tang Kaiyuan, Crown Prince Guest of Honor Xue Rang presented Empress Wu's tripod inscription saying 'The Supreme Mystery descended with insight, and thus Longji was established' — taken as Xuanzong's mandate token.
s0130.idiomatic: Hanlin scholars deliberated, considering: "During Tang Kaiyuan, Crown Prince Guest of Honor Xue Rang presented Empress Wu's tripod inscription saying 'The Supreme Mystery descended with insight, and thus Longji was established' — taken as Xuanzong's mandate token.

s0131.literal: Yao Chong memorialized in congratulations, requesting it be proclaimed to historiographers and announced within and without.
s0131.idiomatic: Yao Chong memorialized in congratulations, requesting it be proclaimed to historiographers and announced within and without.

s0132.literal: But Song scholar Sima Guang condemned taking such coincidental texts as auspicious signs as flattery of petty ministers, while the chief minister validated it — insulting the ruler.
s0132.idiomatic: But Song scholar Sima Guang condemned taking such coincidental texts as auspicious signs as flattery of petty ministers, while the chief minister validated it — insulting the ruler.

s0133.literal: Now Hongjing's lyric, though it seems coincidentally to match birth year and era name, yet Your Majesty received Heaven and followed the people, continuing the legitimate succession; for four years now within and without the seas none have failed to turn their hearts — truly there is no need to rely on side references and forced interpretations as mandate tokens.
s0133.idiomatic: Now Hongjing's lyric, though it seems coincidentally to match birth year and era name, yet Your Majesty received Heaven and followed the people, continuing the legitimate succession; for 4 years now within and without the seas none have failed to turn their hearts — truly there is no need to rely on side references and forced interpretations as mandate tokens.

s0134.literal: Following their words would perhaps open the door to prophecy and weft-texts — not the means to fix the people's will.
s0134.idiomatic: Following their words would perhaps open the door to prophecy and weft-texts — not the means to fix the people's will.

s0136.literal: Prince of Zhao Buluna's fief households — more than sixteen thousand Mongol households in Sha, Jing, and Dening and other places — suffered famine; Hedong pacification commission was ordered to release ten thousand shi of grain from nearby granaries for relief.
s0136.idiomatic: Prince of Zhao Buluna's fief households — more than 16,000 Mongol households in Sha, Jing, and Dening and other places — suffered famine; Hedong pacification commission was ordered to release 10,000 shi of grain from nearby granaries for relief.

s0137.literal: Notes from the Shandong salt levy and grain from the Prince Zhu granary were also issued to relieve famine among the people of Deng and Lai; grain from the Xinghe granary was issued to relieve famine among the people of Baochang.
s0137.idiomatic: Notes from the Shandong salt levy and grain from the Prince Zhu granary were also issued to relieve famine among the people of Deng and Lai; grain from the Xinghe granary was issued to relieve famine among the people of Baochang.

s0138.literal: On wuzi day, the Western monk Xuni Diebadalaban was appointed Tripitaka National Preceptor and granted a gold seal.
s0138.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Western monk Xuni Diebadalaban was appointed Tripitaka National Preceptor and granted a gold seal.

s0139.literal: Longqing Prefecture's Floating-Cup Garden pool, water mill, and fields were granted to Yan Temür.
s0139.idiomatic: Longqing Prefecture's Floating-Cup Garden pool, water mill, and fields were granted to Yan Temür.

s0140.literal: Prince Aru was ordered to garrison Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
s0140.idiomatic: Prince Aru was ordered to garrison Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.

s0141.literal: Registered property of Susu, Bandan, and Cherig Temür was granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.
s0141.idiomatic: Registered property of Susu, Bandan, and Cherig Temür was granted to the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple as perpetual endowment.

s0142.literal: Jiangxi routes in recent years suffered flood and drought; eight hundred fifty thousand-odd famine households — central secretariat officials requested that tenant farmers of official, private, Confucian school, and temple lands borrow grain and money from their masters for self-relief; for the remainder, wealthy households were to be urged to share and grain submitted to purchase office rank; moreover ten thousand ingots of notes from the province were to be added, and ten thousand monk and Taoist ordination certificates were to be issued — approved.
s0142.idiomatic: Jiangxi routes in recent years suffered flood and drought; 850,000-odd famine households — central secretariat officials requested that tenant farmers of official, private, Confucian school, and temple lands borrow grain and money from their masters for self-relief; for the remainder, wealthy households were to be urged to share and grain submitted to purchase office rank; moreover 10,000 ingots of notes from the province were to be added, and 10,000 monk and Taoist ordination certificates were to be issued — approved.

s0143.literal: The chaste conduct of Haimishi, wife of associate administrator of Dadu Prefecture Manu Tulumishi, was commended.
s0143.idiomatic: The chaste conduct of Haimishi, wife of associate administrator of Dadu Prefecture Manu Tulumishi, was commended.

s0144.literal: On jichou day, seven thousand famine households of Yunnei Prefecture and garrison troops at Chahu Lianglou tower were relieved.
s0144.idiomatic: On jichou day, 7,000 famine households of Yunnei Prefecture and garrison troops at Chahu Lianglou tower were relieved.

s0145.literal: On gengyin day, Prince of Weishun Kuanche was ordered back to garrison Huguang.
s0145.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Prince of Weishun Kuanche was ordered back to garrison Huguang.

s0146.literal: An edict ordered that spirit-shrine halls of successive emperors located in various temples each be given a distinguishing name as prefix: Shizu — Yuanshou; Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng — Ruishou; Empress Nambi — Yishou; Yuzong — Mingshou; Chengzong — Guangshou; Shunzong — Yanshou; Wuzong — Renshou; Empress Zhaoxian Zhaosheng — Zhaoshou; Renzong — Wenshou; Yingzong — Xuanshou; Mingzong — Jingshou.
s0146.idiomatic: An edict ordered that spirit-shrine halls of successive emperors located in various temples each be given a distinguishing name as prefix: Shizu — Yuanshou; Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng — Ruishou; Empress Nambi — Yishou; Yuzong — Mingshou; Chengzong — Guangshou; Shunzong — Yanshou; Wuzong — Renshou; Empress Zhaoxian Zhaosheng — Zhaoshou; Renzong — Wenshou; Yingzong — Xuanshou; Mingzong — Jingshou.

s0147.literal: Taoist Ma Daoyi of Bozhou Great Pure Palace, Li Ruone of Bianliang Chaotian Palace, and Zhao Yiran of Henan Song Mountain — each leading his disciples — were summoned to court to perform the Universal Great Offering.
s0147.idiomatic: Taoist Ma Daoyi of Bozhou Great Pure Palace, Li Ruone of Bianliang Chaotian Palace, and Zhao Yiran of Henan Song Mountain — each leading his disciples — were summoned to court to perform the Universal Great Offering.

s0148.literal: More than five thousand salt-worker households of western Zhejiang were relieved.
s0148.idiomatic: More than 5,000 salt-worker households of western Zhejiang were relieved.

s0149.literal: Yuelu Buhua was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Dexing Prefecture.
s0149.idiomatic: Yuelu Buhua was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Dexing Prefecture.

s0150.literal: A supervising censor impeached Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator Tongtong for dissolute indulgence in feasting and ease, talent unfit for assisting governance — an edict dismissed him from office.
s0150.idiomatic: A supervising censor impeached Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator Tongtong for dissolute indulgence in feasting and ease, talent unfit for assisting governance — an edict dismissed him from office.

s0151.literal: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri, Western Pacification Martial and Tranquil Prince Suosi Ban, and others captured Yunnan bandits Yemugan, Luoluo, Totuomuer, Banbu, Aju, Chengjiang Route prefect Luoluo Buhua, Boqu's uncle Qiedegai, falsely appointed wanhu Huladai'er, and various officers — all were beheaded and their corpses dismembered to display publicly.
s0151.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri, Western Pacification Martial and Tranquil Prince Suosi Ban, and others captured Yunnan bandits Yemugan, Luoluo, Totuomuer, Banbu, Aju, Chengjiang Route prefect Luoluo Buhua, Boqu's uncle Qiedegai, falsely appointed wanhu Huladai'er, and various officers — all were beheaded and their corpses dismembered to display publicly.

s0152.literal: More than fourteen thousand Mongol famine households within Liaodong were relieved.
s0152.idiomatic: More than 14,000 Mongol famine households within Liaodong were relieved.

s0153.literal: The chaste conduct of Li Run, wife of Hao Rong of Shandan Prefecture, was commended.
s0153.idiomatic: The chaste conduct of Li Run, wife of Hao Rong of Shandan Prefecture, was commended.

s0154.literal: Locusts in the various counties of Shaan Prefecture.
s0154.idiomatic: Locusts in the various counties of Shaan Prefecture.

s0155.literal: Eight-Fan troops campaigning in Yunnan were all stationed in Guizhou; privy council officials requested envoys be dispatched to issue grain supplies.
s0155.idiomatic: Eight-Fan troops campaigning in Yunnan were all stationed in Guizhou; privy council officials requested envoys be dispatched to issue grain supplies.

s0156.literal: On jihai day, censorate officials impeached and memorialized: "Dadu intendant Liu Yuanren claimed illness and long did not attend to duties; when transferred to associate administrator of the Stored Governance Court he promptly took office — opportunistically clever at office, avoiding difficulty and seeking ease.
s0156.idiomatic: On jihai day, censorate officials impeached and memorialized: "Dadu intendant Liu Yuanren claimed illness and long did not attend to duties; when transferred to associate administrator of the Stored Governance Court he promptly took office — opportunistically clever at office, avoiding difficulty and seeking ease.

s0158.literal: On gengzi day, because the Emperor was about to travel to Shangdu, Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at places where the imperial carriage lodged.
s0158.idiomatic: On gengzi day, because the Emperor was about to travel to Shangdu, Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at places where the imperial carriage lodged.

s0159.literal: On renyin day, because Qipchaq Guard soldiers had increased, they were divided into Left and Right guards.
s0159.idiomatic: On renyin day, because Qipchaq Guard soldiers had increased, they were divided into Left and Right guards.

s0160.literal: One hundred thousand ingots of notes were issued to Yunnan Branch Secretariat for military supplies and civilian provisions.
s0160.idiomatic: 100,000 ingots of notes were issued to Yunnan Branch Secretariat for military supplies and civilian provisions.

s0161.literal: On guimao day, censorate officials impeached and memorialized Minister of Works Su Bing for greedy and wicked conduct — an edict dismissed him.
s0161.idiomatic: On guimao day, censorate officials impeached and memorialized Minister of Works Su Bing for greedy and wicked conduct — an edict dismissed him.

s0162.literal: Datong Route for successive years suffered flood and drought; the people were greatly famished.
s0162.idiomatic: Datong Route for successive years suffered flood and drought; the people were greatly famished.

s0163.literal: Guard soldiers' horse fodder and grain were curtailed, beginning on the first day of the fourth month.
s0163.idiomatic: Guard soldiers' horse fodder and grain were curtailed, beginning on the 1st day of the 4th month.

s0164.literal: More than fourteen thousand five hundred households of seven princely domains — including Prince Shou Tolichu, Prince of Yangdi Temürch, Prince of Xiping Guanbu, and Prince of Chang Balashi — residing in Liaodong reported famine; Liaodong Branch Secretariat was ordered to release grain from nearby granaries for two months' relief.
s0164.idiomatic: More than 14,500 households of 7 princely domains — including Prince Shou Tolichu, Prince of Yangdi Temürch, Prince of Xiping Guanbu, and Prince of Chang Balashi — residing in Liaodong reported famine; Liaodong Branch Secretariat was ordered to release grain from nearby granaries for 2 months' relief.

s0165.literal: Prince of Xuanjing Bainu was ordered to establish prince tutor and other offices.
s0165.idiomatic: Prince of Xuanjing Bainu was ordered to establish prince tutor and other offices.

s0166.literal: The Palace Chancellor Directorate General was established, rank 3a, granted a silver seal.
s0166.idiomatic: The Palace Chancellor Directorate General was established, rank 3a, granted a silver seal.

s0167.literal: Because many Confucian school instructors were in the selection roster, those entering office from interior commands and Jiang-Huai were registered to Jiangxi, Jiang-Zhe, and Huguang;
s0167.idiomatic: Because many Confucian school instructors were in the selection roster, those entering office from interior commands and Jiang-Huai were registered to Jiangxi, Jiang-Zhe, and Huguang;

s0168.literal: those from Shaanxi and the Two Guangs were registered to Fujian;
s0168.idiomatic: those from Shaanxi and the Two Guangs were registered to Fujian;

s0169.literal: those from Gansu, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Fujian were registered to the Two Guangs.
s0169.idiomatic: those from Gansu, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Fujian were registered to the Two Guangs.

s0170.literal: An edict ordered Henan Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Nahai to supervise garrison fields within the province.
s0170.idiomatic: An edict ordered Henan Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Nahai to supervise garrison fields within the province.

s0171.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Reed fields, pond hills, sand flats, and sand fields of Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Songjiang, and Jiangyin that are registered to the state were formerly granted to others; now we request they be re-granted to Yan Temür.
s0171.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Reed fields, pond hills, sand flats, and sand fields of Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Songjiang, and Jiangyin that are registered to the state were formerly granted to others; now we request they be re-granted to Yan Temür.

s0172.literal: " An instruction said: "Yan Temür is not comparable to other ministers; order the offices where they lie to deliver them in full.
s0172.idiomatic: " An instruction said: "Yan Temür is not comparable to other ministers; order the offices where they lie to deliver them in full.

s0173.literal: Government grain from Tongzhou was issued to relieve more than ninety thousand famine households in Tan, Shun, and Changping and other places; three thousand five hundred ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve more than thirty thousand households in Yidu.
s0173.idiomatic: Government grain from Tongzhou was issued to relieve more than 90,000 famine households in Tan, Shun, and Changping and other places; 3,500 ingots of notes from the Shandong salt levy were used to relieve more than 30,000 households in Yidu.

s0174.literal: This month, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat dispatched officials to distribute traveling grain to more than seventy thousand mouths of famine refugees resuming livelihood; more than one thousand mouths of Mongol famine refugees under Prince Bayan Bugan were relieved.
s0174.idiomatic: This month, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat dispatched officials to distribute traveling grain to more than 70,000 mouths of famine refugees resuming livelihood; more than 1,000 mouths of Mongol famine refugees under Prince Bayan Bugan were relieved.

s0175.literal: Zhending and Bianliang two routes, and En, Guan, Jin, Ji, Shen, Li, Jing, and Xian eight prefectures — all had worms eating mulberry leaves as disaster.
s0175.idiomatic: Zhending and Bianliang 2 routes, and En, Guan, Jin, Ji, Shen, Li, Jing, and Xian 8 prefectures — all had worms eating mulberry leaves as disaster.

s0176.literal: The chaste conduct of Liu, wife of the former Revenue Ministry registrar Zhao Ye, was commended.
s0176.idiomatic: The chaste conduct of Liu, wife of the former Revenue Ministry registrar Zhao Ye, was commended.

s0177.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingwu new moon — commoner Wang Tuohuan of Quanning presented a silver mine.
s0177.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingwu new moon — commoner Wang Tuohuan of Quanning presented a silver mine.

s0178.literal: An edict established the Silver Field Intendant Office, subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.
s0178.idiomatic: An edict established the Silver Field Intendant Office, subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

s0179.literal: Central secretariat and privy council officials said: "When troops were raised in the Tianli era, commanders who fought the enemy should have merit rewards fixed.
s0179.idiomatic: Central secretariat and privy council officials said: "When troops were raised in the Tianli era, commanders who fought the enemy should have merit rewards fixed.

s0180.literal: We deliberate: each prince — one hundred taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, one gold belt, and eighteen bolts each of brocaded silks; for ministers, those with four battles or more the same, those with three battles or one battle each with a graded difference.
s0180.idiomatic: We deliberate: each prince — 100 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, 1 gold belt, and 18 bolts each of brocaded silks; for ministers, those with 4 battles or more the same, those with 3 battles or 1 battle each with a graded difference.

s0181.literal: " An instruction said: "Reward scales shall be entirely as you deliberated.
s0181.idiomatic: " An instruction said: "Reward scales shall be entirely as you deliberated.

s0182.literal: Yan Temür first raised the great cause and personally donned armor; Bayan in Henan first executed the double-dealing and made Our road free of worry — the achievements of the two men are without compare; their rewards cannot be the same as the multitude's; grant Yan Temür one seven-jewel belt, four hundred taels of gold, and nine hundred taels of silver; Bayan one gold belt, two hundred taels of gold, and seven hundred taels of silver.
s0182.idiomatic: Yan Temür first raised the great cause and personally donned armor; Bayan in Henan first executed the double-dealing and made Our road free of worry — the achievements of the 2 men are without compare; their rewards cannot be the same as the multitude's; grant Yan Temür 1 seven-jewel belt, 400 taels of gold, and 900 taels of silver; Bayan 1 gold belt, 200 taels of gold, and 700 taels of silver.

s0183.literal: Those receiving rewards numbered ninety-six men in all, using two thousand four hundred taels of gold, fifteen thousand six hundred taels of silver, ninety-one gold belts, and more than one thousand three hundred bolts of silks.
s0183.idiomatic: Those receiving rewards numbered 96 men in all, using 2,400 taels of gold, 15,600 taels of silver, 91 gold belts, and more than 1,300 bolts of silks.

s0184.literal: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites for one month each at Wutai and Wuling Mountains to pray for blessings for Crown Prince Gunadala.
s0184.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites for 1 month each at Wutai and Wuling Mountains to pray for blessings for Crown Prince Gunadala.

s0185.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain was issued for relief sale to the capital's poor.
s0185.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of grain was issued for relief sale to the capital's poor.

s0186.literal: On wushen day, the Emperor's paternal aunt, Grand Princess of Lu State, died.
s0186.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor's paternal aunt, Grand Princess of Lu State, died.

s0187.literal: The Korean woman Buyan Teni in the palace was granted to Yan Temür; the king of Goryeo requested fields in the country be cut as dowry provision — an edict dispatched envoys to receive them.
s0187.idiomatic: The Korean woman Buyan Teni in the palace was granted to Yan Temür; the king of Goryeo requested fields in the country be cut as dowry provision — an edict dispatched envoys to receive them.

s0188.literal: Three thousand guard soldiers were issued to assist labor at the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple.
s0188.idiomatic: 3,000 guard soldiers were issued to assist labor at the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple.

s0189.literal: On gengxu day, an edict ordered construction of Yan Temür's living shrine south of Hongqiao, with a stele erected to record his achievements.
s0189.idiomatic: On gengxu day, an edict ordered construction of Yan Temür's living shrine south of Hongqiao, with a stele erected to record his achievements.

s0190.literal: Censorate officials said: "Associate administrator Cao Li, though repeatedly serving Jiang-Zhe and now idle and dismissed, still associates and exchanges with wealthy households — he should be sent back to his home register of Datong Route.
s0190.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Associate administrator Cao Li, though repeatedly serving Jiang-Zhe and now idle and dismissed, still associates and exchanges with wealthy households — he should be sent back to his home register of Datong Route.

s0191.literal: Moreover, supervising censor Wan Jialu once recommended associate censor-in-chief Heshang; Tuotuo once recommended surveillance commissioner Bozan'er — now Heshang and Bozan'er have both been removed for bribery crimes; Wan Jialu and Tuotuo can hardly bear censorate and secretariat posts.
s0191.idiomatic: Moreover, supervising censor Wan Jialu once recommended associate censor-in-chief Heshang; Tuotuo once recommended surveillance commissioner Bozan'er — now Heshang and Bozan'er have both been removed for bribery crimes; Wan Jialu and Tuotuo can hardly bear censorate and secretariat posts.

s0193.literal: Wuzhi County of Zhending Wuzhou suffered earthquake; for more than a month it did not cease.
s0193.idiomatic: Wuzhi County of Zhending Wuzhou suffered earthquake; for more than 1 month it did not cease.

s0194.literal: On renzi day, Yan Temür was ordered to take overall charge of Palace Chancellor Directorate General affairs; Yelburen and Barsar were both to hold their original offices concurrently as darughachi of the Palace Chancellor Directorate General.
s0194.idiomatic: On renzi day, Yan Temür was ordered to take overall charge of Palace Chancellor Directorate General affairs; Yelburen and Barsar were both to hold their original offices concurrently as darughachi of the Palace Chancellor Directorate General.

s0195.literal: Prince Qariman dispatched envoys to court with tribute.
s0195.idiomatic: Prince Qariman dispatched envoys to court with tribute.

s0196.literal: On jiayin day, the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office was changed to the Xuanzhong Alan Imperial Guard Army Commanders Office and granted a silver seal.
s0196.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Xuanzhong Imperial Guard Army Commander-in-Chief's Office was changed to the Xuanzhong Alan Imperial Guard Army Commanders Office and granted a silver seal.

s0197.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Prince of Yue Tula in Wuzong's time had Shaoxing Route as fief, annually cutting and granting that route's rent and tax notes of forty thousand ingots; now his son Alaqtenashiri has inherited the princely title — half should be granted annually.
s0197.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Prince of Yue Tula in Wuzong's time had Shaoxing Route as fief, annually cutting and granting that route's rent and tax notes of 40,000 ingots; now his son Alaqtenashiri has inherited the princely title — half should be granted annually.

s0199.literal: On yimao day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.
s0199.idiomatic: On yimao day, seasonal offering at the Grand Temple.

s0200.literal: Western Pacification Martial and Tranquil Prince Suosi Ban and others, having pacified Yunnan, each dispatched envoys to report victory.
s0200.idiomatic: Western Pacification Martial and Tranquil Prince Suosi Ban and others, having pacified Yunnan, each dispatched envoys to report victory.
